text: I love this planner in concept - it finally can get me out of the spiraling fear of forgetting something, decision paralysis, and time blindness. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is the add/edit tasks page is buggy. Sometimes there are significant delays when clicking on a task to edit, and sometimes the taps to change something in the task aren't registered. Also, not a deal breaker but I wish there was more flexibility in the color coded categorizing.
author: Sebastian Greenholtz (greenmntmagpie)
developer_reply: Hi Sebastian! Thank you for the lovely review 💙 We're so glad NowNextLater is helping! A new update is now available that addresses the delays and missed taps when adding or editing tasks. Please give it a try! We've also added your suggestion for more flexible colour-coded categories to our improvement list. Thanks again!

text: An app that actually does help adhders make decisions and get tasks done
author: Tina Crocker
developer_reply: Thank you so much, Tina! 💙 This genuinely means the world to us! Helping ADHD brains overcome decision paralysis and actually get things done is exactly why we created NowNextLater. 🧠✨ We're so happy it's making a difference for you. Reviews like yours inspire us to keep improving the app. Thank you for being part of our journey! 💙

text: Almost perfect! It would be 5⭐ and Pro forever if I could import from Google Tasks (but I'm happy to accept this might just be a me thing!)
author: Rebecca Samuels
developer_reply: Thank you so much, Rebecca! 💙 And no, it's definitely not just you! Google Tasks import is a brilliant suggestion, and we'll add it to our feature request list. 🧠✨ We want NowNextLater to work around your life, not make you start from scratch. Feedback like yours helps us make the app even better. Thanks for your support! 💙

text: I can see it working really well, but at the same time there's so much yet to be optimized. Can't upload photos into the main nudge either, only via the quick capture; unfortunately that makes getting a wrangle on multiple to do lists difficult because things can only be parsed in small batches.
author: Hali Hall
developer_reply: Hi Hali, sorry to hear that you are having issue with that feature. When you normally open the camera button with Nudge it will go to the add task menu from there you can upload a written task list for nudge to add as tasks. Any other issues please do reach out to nownextlatersupport@gmail.com

text: Started the app one evening and realised it would be better to do it in the morning. Time passed until I could try it and it's timed me out trying without a commitment. Might be worth looking into cumulative time rather than calendar time for folk who struggle with memory and focus... Might be great. Not creating yet another account to find out
author: Alan Shaw
developer_reply: Hi Alan, please can you reach out to nownextlatersupport@gmail.com to clarify this.

text: I like the system and am interested in exploring it more, but keep running into a frustrating issue. When adding a task with details the app partially locks. I can enter the name of the task, but the rest of the buttons on the screen don't work. This includes the save and back buttons. I have to manually close the app to fix the issue. I'd love to continue using the app and am interested in keeping pro after the trial, but as is this issue would keep me from doing so.
author: Bill Goode
developer_reply: Hi Bill, sorry to hear about the issue you have been facing. We have rolled out a new app version to address these issues. It should be available shortly :)

text: Missing a lot of key features, unintentionally frustrating ui.
author: Rachel Quaday
developer_reply: Hi Rachel! Thanks for trying NowNextLater. We're sorry the experience hasn't met your expectations. We're constantly improving the app based on user feedback, and we'd genuinely love to know which features you feel are missing or what you found frustrating. Please email nownextlatersupport@gmail.com so we can look into it. 💚

text: as what I have tried I like but had to uninstall can't pay for the promo right now will suggest adding a meal planner onto it and being able to rearrange the tasks

developer_reply: Hi Glenda! 💚 Thank you for the 5 stars! Just so you know, NowNextLater has a free plan, so you don't need to pay to keep using it! 😊 Tasks are prioritised based on your energy level, but I love your suggestions for manually rearranging tasks and adding a meal planner. I'll definitely look into both! We'd love to have you back! 💚💙💜

text: I don't actually get notifications from this app, so I forgot I even downloaded it.
author: Isaac of Rivia
developer_reply: Hi Isaac, thanks for the feedback but we havent had any other complaints from users about notifications. Reach out to nownextlatersupport@gmail.com please

text: I really like this app and want to use it, but it has some fatal flaws& I'm not sure I can work around them. My biggest problem is setting the task repetition. You can't customize it enough. I can't set it every 4 days, I can't set it 4 days after last completed. It's daily weekly etc or set days. If I want to do a task approx weekly, I want it to stay in my task list until I do it and then come back after a week. I don't want it to just be there every Saturday. Lots of apps like this can do it
author: Cherie
developer_reply: Hi Cherie! 😊 Great news! Thanks to your feedback, we've now added flexible repeats! You can set tasks to repeat every 4 days, weekly, or any custom interval, starting from when you last completed them. Tasks can stay until they're done, then return when due. Coming in our next update! Thanks for helping us improve NowNextLater! 💚

text: the all is great but please change the icon it looks awful as it is and is clipped on both sides
author: Mike Roebuck
developer_reply: Hi Mike! 😊 Thanks for the feedback and the 4 stars! We've listened and redesigned the app icon to fix the clipping issue on both sides. The new icon will be included in our next update. Really glad you're enjoying NowNextLater, and we appreciate you helping us make it better! 💚💙💜

text: I haven't gotten too into it yet, but the fact that it isn't begging for my credit card info from the jump is already impressive. It's what made me want to give the app a try in the first place! I really like the supportive and non-judgmental language. it's actually pretty easy to input tasks, and I feel a little more capable than I did yesterday! One thing I'd like to have is a widget that allows you to adjust your energy level in real time. I think it would pair well with the current widget.
author: Zaa Lynn
developer_reply: Hi Zaa! 😊 Your review made our day! We're so glad NowNextLater is helping you feel more capable. We've now added your suggestion! You can adjust your energy (Low, Normal or High) directly from the Android widget with one tap. It'll be available in our next update! Thanks for helping shape NowNextLater! 💚💙💜

text: so.... what an experience. as a full fat unmedicated ADHD person at the minute I downloaded this because I love the idea of breaking down bigger tasks, planning my day, getting dopamine rewards for completing stuff. but on downloading the app, I was presented with an incredibly complicated interface, and constant visual tutorial bits that made no sense to my brain, trying to complete them brought me out in a sweat and a panic so I immediately deleted it. past the intro, maybe it's ok.
author: Martijn
developer_reply: Thanks for the detailed feedback, Martijn. NowNextLater is built for ADHD brains, so if the intro felt overwhelming, that’s something I need to improve. I’m already simplifying the first-run experience so users start with one simple task and discover features gradually. Really appreciate you explaining what happened.

text: the theory of this app is brilliant except i keep procrastinating putting any chores on it lol, ill get to it eventually, i would put it on my list except...yeah. Nothing against the app tho, from what ive seen its great

text: Simple, clean, and really helpful. It makes organizing my tasks much easier and helps me stay focused. Definitely worth trying!

text: NowNextLater makes it much easier to organize my tasks without feeling overwhelmed. The Now, Next, and Later system is simple, practical, and easy to use.

text: A few unusual things about this app. first of all, to order the pro you don't have to put payment details in an actual trial that cancels on its own is genius, especially as it's aimed ADHD people who forget to cancel and end up paying for somet hing they don't use. the second most genius is it's really good in its free format without a million ads and things that are slow me down frustrate me and turn me off about an app. and finally in its Pro format it's a dream with or without ADHD
author: Angela Smith

text: I was diagnosed with ADHD later in life, and this app has genuinely made such a difference to my day-to-day life. My son created it, and I’m amazed at how much it helps me stay organised, plan my day and actually get things done. Things that used to feel overwhelming now feel much more manageable. I’m incredibly proud of him for creating something that has helped me so much. Highly recommended for anyone with ADHD!
author: Mark Nichols
